question: Does preserving the Hangzhou supply-to-response correspondence improve forward prediction on fresh Jinan seeds within the seven shared conditions?
next_step: Preaction-only opportunity census on four fresh Jinan PP seeds. Keep all response outcomes sealed until the roster is fixed.

source_models.placement_control: All 5040 joint right/straight permutations of the seven Hangzhou point labels.

network: Same admitted Jinan v9 and original demand as ../tsc_joint_response_trial_20261106/protocol_v2.json
census: One hour per seed, all 12 signals at every 10s decision. Use the same dedicated yielding-right/priority-straight merge, projected identical right traces and high4/low0 rule. No intervention in the census. Stop on safety, replay or measurement failure.
selection: Within each seed process the seven points in ascending order, keep the earliest eligible new timestamp and distinct both-supplied visit, breaking ties by signal and movement ids. Report missing points. If each point is represented by at least two seeds, freeze available cases, at most 28 pairs, for a separate response readout. Otherwise stop and report coverage.
later_readout: Keep clearance extensions, and score both movement deltas by absolute error, averaging movements within case, the represented seeds within point and then the seven points equally. Report paired per-seed losses, the full permutation distribution and the historical target-only lookup alongside the matched and constant source predictions. All controls are frozen before acquisition. Predictive evidence here concerns local movement counts; policy benefit requires a separate matched-capacity source addition/removal study and evaluation on untouched control seeds.
